description: Every body of the stock Kerbol system as KSP holds it at UT=0 after PSystemManager spawn, CelestialBody Awake/Start, OrbitDriver.Start and the first Planetarium.FixedUpdate/CBUpdate. Serialized inputs come from the PSystem prefab in sharedassets9.assets (see golden/serialized/celestial_bodies.serialized.json). Derived quantities: Mass/gravParameter/gMagnitudeAtCenter/SOI/hillSphere/solar-period conversion/rotation values are RE-HOSTED expressions of Awake/Start/CBUpdate (Rehosted/CelestialBodyLifecycle.cs); atmosphere constants come from the real CelestialBody.SetupConstants(); orbit quantities from the real Orbit.Init()/UpdateFromUT(0); atmosphere profiles from the real GetPressure/GetTemperature/GetDensity/GetSpeedOfSound.

provenance.float_semantics: IEEE-754 binary32/binary64, SSE2 (RyuJIT x64); libm from the .NET Framework CLR, not Unity's Mono

tables.name: bodies
tables.description: Physical and rotational parameters per body (in-game state at UT=0).

tables.name: orbits
tables.description: Orbital elements relative to the parent body (KSP inertial frame, Planetarium.Zup applied) and the state at UT=0 from Orbit.UpdateFromUT(0).

tables.name: atmosphere_profile_1km
tables.description: Real CelestialBody atmosphere functions at 1 km steps from 0 to atmosphereDepth (inclusive), plus depth+1 m.

tables.name: body_curves
tables.description: Keyframes of every FloatCurve on each CelestialBody exactly as serialized (float32). Wrap modes are Unity-native values (2 = clamp).
